source_en: Merhaba, officer! Grim day, no? Murat Celik, trader. Textiles, mostly.
Papers, ID, and my lucky chestnut. The bazaar never fully closes.
More than ever! Less silk, more batteries and candles.
Every road is dangerous. The dangerous ones lead somewhere interesting.
I live with my son. Three noisy grandchildren.
Yesterday it was! Samuil's tea is still strong. Some things don't end.
Three market crashes, two floods, one very aggressive goat. Perspective!
Keep the chestnut in mind, officer. Luck is rationed too.
